refnamediv.refpurpose: This function estimate midcross values of real vector X.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: midcrossvalue=midcross(x) midcrossvalue=midcross(x, Fs) midcrossvalue=midcross(x, t) midcrossvalue=midcross(x, t, 'MidPercentReferenceLevels', N ) midcrossvalue=midcross(x, t, 'Tolerance', M) midcrossvalue=midcross(x, t,'StateLevels', O) [midcrossvalue midreference]=midcross(x) [midcrossvalue midreference]=midcross(x, Fs) [midcrossvalue midreference]=midcross(x, t) [midcrossvalue midreference]= midcross(x, t, 'MidPercentReferenceLevel', N ) [midcrossvalue midreference]= midcross(x, t, 'Tolerance', M) [midcrossvalue midreference]= midcross(x, t,'StateLevels', O) [midcrossvalue midreference]= midcross(x, t,'StateLevels', O, 'fig', on or off)

listitem.para: specifies the sample rate, Fs, as a positive scalar, where the first sample instant corresponds to a time of zero.
defiene instant sample time t as vector with same length of x, or specifies the sample rate, t, as a positive scalar
specify the midpercentreferenceleves as a percentage, default value of N is 50.
define the tolerance value as real scaler value, where default value of M is 2.0.
define the lower and upper state levels as two element real vector.
specify the logical input value to display figure as one of 'on' or 'off', where the default input in 'off'.
return t value, which given as input parameter.
